clauses.quote: All Contractors shall take all necessary and reasonable steps to ensure that minority owned businesses have the maximum opportunity to compete for and perform Board contracts.
clauses.notes: Relates to third-party contractor procurement obligations rather than direct employment terms.

clauses.quote: construction contracts shall be awarded to the lowest responsive and responsible bidder
clauses.notes: District procurement rule mandating award to lowest compliant bidder.

clauses.quote: 25% of the total dollar amount available each fiscal year to the Board for contracts covered by this Policy shall be spent with minority andlor disadvantaged businesses.
clauses.subject_text: 25% of the total dollar amount available each fiscal year to the Board for contracts covered by this Policy
clauses.notes: District spending target for minority and disadvantaged business contracts.
